the effective degrees of freedom in the QGP phase are not the quarks and gluons themselves, but rather a mixture of hadronic and quark degrees of freedom.
QGP and hadronic matter coexist in a narrow temperature range around the transition temperature, and that the effective degrees of freedom in this range are dominated by the hadronic phase.
